attributes.description: Azure Observe & Protect cockpit with Datadog-comparable insight fabric: mirrored Security KPIs, service coverage matrix, events timeline, live asset inventory, OOTB integration nav, and recommendation workflows.
attributes.optionsJSON: {"autoApplyFilters": true, "hidePanelTitles": false, "hidePanelBorders": false, "useMargins": true, "syncColors": true, "syncTooltips": true, "syncCursor": true}

config.title: Virtual machine
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-azure.compute_vm-default | STATS BY COALESCE(azure.resource.name, cloud.instance.name, cloud.instance.id)

config.title: Storage account
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-azure.storage_account-default | STATS BY COALESCE(azure.resource.name, azure.storage_account.name)

config.title: Billing service
config.esql_query: FROM metrics-azure.billing-default | STATS BY COALESCE(azure.billing.product, azure.billing.meter_name, azure.billing.service_name)
